revision_rule.note: IEEE 1800-2012 states that array nets and unpacked struct nets lack a value property, but does not extend this guarantee to unpacked union nets or interconnect arrays.
The 2017 rule excludes value properties only for array nets and unpacked struct nets; it does not include unpacked union nets or interconnect arrays.
The 2017 constant-select condition did not include union-net elements, so its bound-stability guarantee covered a narrower set of selects.
IEEE 1800-2012 represents whether a constraint is extern with the Boolean vpiExtern property rather than the vpiAccessType values vpiExternAcc or zero.
The 2012 constraint object model exposes extern status through Boolean vpiExtern, whereas the current model requires the integer vpiAccessType property.
IEEE 1800-2012 provides the frame model for automatic variables and events but does not include automatic nets or net/net-array resolution-function origins.
The 2017 frame model covers scope/call origins and automatic variables/events but does not include net origins or automatic nets.
IEEE 1800-2012 exposes vpiOrigin for procedural scopes and calls, but not the later net or net-array origin semantics for user-defined resolution-function frames.
The 2017 frame model has an origin relation for scopes and calls, but does not specify net or net-array origins for user-defined resolution-function frames.
IEEE 1800-2012 diagrams the parent-frame relationship but does not specify that the parent frame's stmt transition identifies the atomic statement or scope that activated the child.
The 2017 diagram provides a parent-frame relation but does not guarantee that the parent frame's statement identifies the activation point.
IEEE 1800-2012 defines frames for automatic variables declared in tasks or functions, rather than for every dynamically activated procedural scope with local automatic events and event arrays.
The 2017 frame rule represents automatic variables of activated tasks/functions, not every dynamically activated procedural scope with local events and event arrays.
The IEEE 1800-2012 generate model has the other listed relationships but does not include the later vpiNetTypedef relationship to nettype declarations.
IEEE 1800-2012 defines the interconnect language construct but has no corresponding VPI generic-interconnect net/array object model or relationships.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no VPI object model for generic interconnect nets and interconnect arrays.
IEEE 1800-2012 has no vpiNetTypedef iteration exposing user-defined nettype declarations from an instance.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no vpiNetTypedef iteration for explicitly declared user-defined nettypes.
The IEEE 1800-2012 instance model includes the other listed instance metadata and relationships but not the later vpiNetTypedef relationship to nettype declarations.
The 2017 instance model lacks the vpiNetTypedef relationship for user-defined nettype declarations.
IEEE 1800-2012 has no VPI interconnect aggregate model providing vpiElement or vpiMember traversal.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no VPI aggregate traversal model for interconnect nets.
IEEE 1800-2012 has no VPI interconnect-array object model or dimension-by-dimension vpiElement iteration rule.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no VPI interconnect-array element iteration rule.
IEEE 1800-2012 has no VPI interconnect-array object and therefore no guarantee that its vpiTypespec is NULL.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no VPI interconnect-array object or associated typespec guarantee.
IEEE 1800-2012 does not define the VPI vpiInterconnect net-type result for interconnect net or array objects.
IEEE 1800-2017 does not define vpiInterconnect as the VPI net type for interconnect objects.
IEEE 1800-2012 has no VPI guarantee exposing the resolved simulated-net type of an interconnect net.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no VPI resolved-net-type guarantee for interconnect nets.
IEEE 1800-2012 has no VPI interconnect-net typespec relationship derived from connected nets.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no VPI rule deriving an interconnect net typespec from connected nets.
The 2017 constant-select condition includes struct members and static-bound array members but not union-net members.
IEEE 1800-2012 does not specify the later vpiDecompile, vpiFullName, and vpiName formatting guarantee for struct/union member nets and indexed slices.
IEEE 1800-2012 does not require aggregate member-net lookup to use vpiDecompile in relative contexts and vpiFullName at top level.
The IEEE 1800-2012 net model lacks the later VPI interconnect-net and user-defined-net forms and their associated relationships and properties.
The 2017 net model lacks interconnect-net and interconnect-array object forms and relationships.
IEEE 1800-2012 defines the non-scalar vector case specifically for integer and time nets, rather than for every other integral net type as in the current rule.

IEEE 1800-2012 specifies sizes for array, unpacked-struct, enum, integer, logic, time, packed-struct, packed-array, and bit nets, but not the later interconnect, unpacked-union, or general integral-net cases.
The 2017 size rule covers array nets, integral nets, net bits, and unpacked structures, but not interconnects or unpacked unions.
IEEE 1800-2012 makes vpiStructUnionMember true for direct members of struct nets, but does not include direct members of union nets in the guarantee.
The 2017 property recognizes direct members of struct nets only and specifies FALSE for net bits; it does not cover union-net parents as the 2023 rule does.
IEEE 1800-2012 has no VPI nettype-declaration object or vpiNetTypedefAlias relationship.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no VPI nettype-declaration alias relationship.
IEEE 1800-2012 has no VPI nettype-declaration object model exposing alias, typespec, resolution function, and name.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no VPI object model for nettype declarations.
IEEE 1800-2012 does not define VPI vpiNettypeNet and vpiNettypeNetSelect classifications.
IEEE 1800-2017 does not define vpiNettypeNet or vpiNettypeNetSelect classifications.
IEEE 1800-2012 has no VPI vpiWith relationship for nettype declarations and no corresponding NULL guarantee.
IEEE 1800-2017 has no VPI vpiWith guarantee for a nettype declaration.
IEEE 1800-2012 does not define vpiNettypeNetSelect or its unsupported driver-iteration behavior.
IEEE 1800-2017 does not define vpiNettypeNetSelect or its driver-iteration restriction.
IEEE 1800-2012 defines the same dimension-by-dimension iteration but lists only struct and enum leaf nets, not union-net leaves.
IEEE 1800-2012 applies vpiPackedArrayMember to packed struct, enum, and packed-array net elements, but does not include packed union net elements.
IEEE 1800-2012 defines the explicit-range rule for packed struct and enum nets but does not include packed union nets.
IEEE 1800-2012 does not specify the later vpiDecompile, vpiFullName, and vpiName formatting guarantee for struct, union, or class-variable members and indexed slices.
IEEE 1800-2012 does not require variable-member lookup to use vpiDecompile in relative contexts and vpiFullName at top level.
